Help.Help.Title: Help
Help.About.Title: About
Help.About.Body:
DevProjex is a cross-platform open-source tool for quickly preparing project context: analyzing structure, flexibly selecting files, configuring exclusions, previewing, copying, and exporting the tree or contents. The GUI, TUI, and CLI let you work with local folders and Git repositories, creating clean context for AI assistants, code reviews, learning, and documentation.

Processing is local, and the opened project remains read-only: DevProjex does not modify source files or upload their contents to external services, and it collects no telemetry.

The source code is open for study and modification; architectural suggestions and improvements (PRs) are welcome as part of the project's development.

Terminal.Tui.Welcome.HelpBody:
DEVPROJEX TERMINAL
Prepare controlled project context without leaving the terminal.

WELCOME
Open the current folder, choose a folder, clone a repository, or use Recent Workspaces for local folders and Git repositories. The list opens from saved history without network access; repository cache is checked only after selection. Open project with settings file is available from the Action Palette.

WORKSPACE
Tree controls selection. Preview shows Tree, Content, or Tree + Content in ASCII, JSON, XML, or Markdown. Parameters exposes Git filtering, Exclusions, File Types, and Root Folders. Ctrl+P opens every action, including exports and Desktop.

NAVIGATION
Up/Down or j/k moves, Enter opens, Space toggles, Tab/F6 changes panes, Shift reverses direction, / searches, and ? opens contextual Help. Esc closes one overlay or clears the current search.

OPERATIONS
Measured work shows real progress. Esc or Ctrl+C cancels active work first and keeps Terminal open. Only Exit or q on a root screen closes it.

Terminal.Tui.HelpBody:
WORKSPACE
Tree selects files and folders. Preview inspects the current context. Parameters changes Git filtering, Smart Secrets, Exclusions, File Types, and Root Folders.

ACTION PALETTE
Ctrl+P lists every important action and shortcut. Type to filter, use Up/Down, then Enter. Esc restores the previous pane.

PREVIEW AND SEARCH
1/2/3 selects Tree, Content, or Tree + Content. F selects ASCII, JSON, XML, or Markdown. / filters Tree names when Tree is focused and searches the complete Preview document when Preview is focused. n/N moves between Preview matches. Esc clears the active search.

EXPORTS
E exports the context document. Z opens a physical project copy to a folder or ZIP destination. The summary shows selection, destination, diagnostics, and the equivalent CLI command.

OPERATIONS
Esc or Ctrl+C cancels active work before any quit action. Recoverable errors return to the previous screen.
Terminal.Tui.Help.Tree:
PROJECT TREE
Up/Down or j/k navigates rows. Page Up/Page Down moves a page; Home/End moves to the first/last row. Left/Right collapses or expands, Enter opens a folder, and Space toggles selection. / searches the tree. Tab/F6 moves to Preview; Shift+Tab/Shift+F6 moves to Parameters.
Terminal.Tui.Help.Preview:
CONTEXT PREVIEW
Up/Down or j/k scrolls one line; Page Up/Page Down scrolls a page; Home/End moves to the beginning/end; Left/Right scrolls horizontally when needed. / searches the complete document, n/N selects the next/previous match, and Esc clears search. 1/2/3 changes Preview mode; F selects ASCII, JSON, XML, or Markdown. Tab/F6 moves to Parameters; Shift+Tab/Shift+F6 returns to Tree.
Terminal.Tui.Help.Controls:
PARAMETERS
Up/Down or j/k selects a row; Enter changes the selected radio button, checkbox, or All control. This panel contains Git filtering, Smart Secrets, Exclusions, File Types, Root Folders, and an unobtrusive saved-settings indicator when applicable. Use Ctrl+P for actions, E for context export, and Z for folder/ZIP export. Tab/F6 returns to Tree; Shift+Tab/Shift+F6 moves to Preview.
